packageRules.description: Group kube-prometheus-stack with its companion CRDs chart - they're versioned independently but released in lockstep against the same prometheus-operator appVersion
Group mariadb-operator with its companion CRDs chart - previously merged as separate PRs (#58/#60, #87/#89)

Auto-merge patch updates for non-critical dependencies. matchManagers covers three managers, not just 'flux': 'regex' for the customManagers above (our kubeconform CI-version manager and the cnpg.json5 preset's CNPG imageName/extension manager are customType:regex), and 'kubernetes' because that manager does its own generic line-scan for `image:` fields in any file that looks like a k8s manifest (apiVersion+kind present) - it's what actually catches images embedded in raw CRDs the flux manager doesn't parse (e.g. the ClickHouseInstallation CR, PR #421). Without all three, matching deps get detected but never auto-merged, unlike everything else at this update level.
